Planned MQL5 Marketplace EAs Selected tools, with documented behavior and limitations
Q00 Research Intake Checks that a strategy idea has a real, citable source, is mechanical, is testable on our instruments, and uses no machine learning
Q01 Build & Spec Builds the mechanical idea into an Expert Advisor with a written specification
Q02 Baseline Screening Screens each market for a profitable, active baseline signal on in-sample history before any deeper testing
Q03 Parameter Sweep Tests whether the result holds across a stable band of settings, not just one tuned value
Q04 Walk-Forward + Commission Runs anchored walk-forward on unseen out-of-sample years with realistic ECN commission applied
Q05 Gross Full-History Robustness Replays the robust settings across the entire available history to see if the edge survives every regime
Q06 Stress HARSH Examines how the result changes when some intended fills do not execute
Q07 Multi-Seed Repeats the test with different random seeds to inspect sensitivity to execution ordering
Q08 Davey Statistical Validation Reviews statistical and robustness evidence, including sample size and selection effects
Q09 Baseline Full Run Freezes a full-history, pre-news baseline as the fixed reference for the later sealed comparison

Q10 News Impact + FTMO Recommendation Compares news-handling and venue-compliance settings across the relevant settings, then seals one locked configuration for the two programs we target — Darwinex Zero and FTMO-style prop challenges
Q11 Incumbent Full-History Confirmation Re-confirms the locked configuration over each symbol's full available history with realistic costs
Q12 Pattern Filter Selection Considers a small, preregistered set of pattern filters; selecting none is a valid outcome
Q13 Parameter Optimization & Freeze Re-optimises parameters on development data only, then freezes the result as a new challenger identity
What can stop progress: The frozen challenger cannot clear its own fresh Q02-Q11 cascade as a new EA

Q14 Best-Settings Head-to-Head + Holdout Compares the frozen challenger against its baseline and incumbent on sealed out-of-sample and holdout windows; keeping the incumbent is a valid terminal result
Q15 Final Portfolio Construction Admits survivors as portfolio members under correlation, family and symbol caps; entered only via the book trigger
Q16 Operational Readiness Checks the release artifact, execution configuration and operational safeguards
Q17 Live Burn-In DXZ Observes execution under the approved burn-in plan before any scaling decision
